bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are not permitted. Small bags under 12 inches are allowed and will be searched.
bagPolicy.note: All ticket holders are subject to security screening. Artist or event restrictions may be stricter.

parking.note: Parking is available at the Center Stage Garage for $10-$25 and the Midtown Plaza Deck for $17.50. Both accept credit, debit, and ParkMobile, but no cash. Limited complimentary parking is available for box office visits.

rideshare.note: For your safety, please use 17th Street (b/w West Peachtree St & Spring St) for Uber, Lyft, or Taxi.

concessions.note: Center Stage, The Loft, and Vinyl have bars. Snacks are available at the bar, and certain shows also offer pizza.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating can be arranged by calling the venue at (404) 885-1365 or emailing info@rivalentertainment.com.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Center Stage Theater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the entrance to each room. Bring a valid photo ID. The box office also sells tickets in person during posted hours and, when available, at show entry.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors are generally scheduled to open one hour before the time printed on the ticket. Lines often form near 17th Street and West Peachtree Street.
